Creature2 row by id: DAT_140c63840 dispatcher with descriptor PTR_u_Creature2_140a69c60 else ClientDB_RegisterCreature2 then DAT_140c63d10 vtable +0x18. Re-derived 2026-11-10.

Copies a Creature2 row (ClientDB_GetCreature2) into a runtime creature info: row +0x150/+0x154/+0x158 to info +0x90/+0x94/+0x98 plus level-range words clamped to 16 bits at info +0xb0/+0xb2 and a Creature2Difficulty lookup. Re-derived 2026-11-10; the Flags/UiFlags/ActivationFlags naming of the three words is from RESTORATION_GAP8_SPELL_EFFECT_NATIVE_READS_20261108.md.

Calls CreatureInfo_FillFromCreature2Row then allocates optional sub-blocks at info +0xc0 (0x20 bytes from row +0x3c..+0x58) and +0xc8 (0xc bytes from row +0x15c..+0x164) and +0xd0 (0x28 bytes from row +0x274..+0x298) when any source word is non-zero. Re-derived 2026-11-10.

Builds one creature info entry: calls CreatureInfo_BuildFromCreature2Id with the first word of its third argument then resolves Creature2Difficulty and InstancePortal rows and manager lists at this +0x58/+0x78. Re-derived 2026-11-10 for the call and table lookups only; the virtual-method and entity +0x18 claims of the 2026-11-08 note were not re-read.
Spell4Effects row by id: DAT_140c63840 dispatcher with descriptor PTR_u_Spell4Effects_140a6d268 else ClientDB_RegisterSpell4Effects then DAT_140c63ba0 vtable +0x18. Re-derived 2026-11-10.

Zeroes a 0xa8-byte runtime effect then copies a Spell4Effects row (ClientDB_GetSpell4Effects) into it when the SpellEffectType-style row from FUN_14023e0c0 has flag bit 1 set: type to +0x10 and delay +0x20 and tick +0x24 and duration +0x38 and flags +0x3c and DataBits00-09 to +0x40..+0x64. Re-derived 2026-11-10; callers not re-read.

Returns 1 when creature info (entity +0x18) flag word +0x90 bit 0x40000000 is clear and a tag owner (entity +0x124 or +0x128) is set and entity +0x130 is 0 and the owner differs from the unit at DAT_140c65898 +0x78. Re-derived 2026-11-10; reading that unit as the local player is from the 2026-11-08 note.

Prerequisite types 194 and 195 (vtable +0xf8 / +0x100): local player only; walks the WorldZone chain of the unit zone id (+0x17e8) via WorldZoneTree_FindNode; flag 0x10 denies; allow bit 0x100 required when unit +0x16f0 virtual +0x78 returns 0.
Prerequisite type 197 (vtable +0x108): same body as 14049ced0 with WorldZone deny bit 0x40 and allow bit 0x200.
Prerequisite type 198 (vtable +0x110): same body as 14049ced0 with WorldZone deny bit 0x80 and allow bit 0x400.
Looks a zone id up in the zone tree at local-player global +0x7160; node +8 is the WorldZone row (flags at +0x1c) and node +0x10 the parent node.
Walks the WorldZone chain for a deny/allow bit pair chosen by vehicle kind: kinds 0 1 4 8 9 use 0x10/0x100; 6 uses 0x40/0x200; 7 uses 0x80/0x400; other kinds are always allowed.
Returns the loaded residence that has a plot whose HousingPlotInfo world socket id (row +4) equals the argument; 0 for socket 0. Used by prerequisite types 182 and 186.

Prerequisite type 182 (vtable +0x620): Player/Ghost unit and second unit required; residence from Housing_FindResidenceByWorldSocket(secondUnit +0x172c); tail-calls the general comparison on residence +0x20 and unit +0x1a8.
Per-player map at +0x7eb0 keyed by PetFlair id; returns the stored count (node +0x24) or 0. Compared by prerequisite type 190 with the count the PetFlair row expects.

Spell service vtable +0x40: looks a spell effect group id up in the map at service +0x740 (filled from Spell4EffectGroupList by Spell4Manager_BuildRuntimeData) and returns its effect id vector; 0 for group 0.

Prerequisite type 178 (case 0xb2; vtable +0x140): ObjectId is an ItemSlot id; lowest set bit of equippedSlotFlags indexes the local player indexed storage (selector 0); flag is entry present; Equal/NotEqual; no row answers NotEqual only; Value not read.
Returns the RealmDataCenter row for an id; the application object keeps the row for the realmDataCenterId launch argument at +0x16e8.
True when the quest of the supplied quest node is present in the active quest map of the quest runtime (DAT_140c65b80).

Quest node; objective index; slot: active quest; objective exists and passes Quest_IsChecklistObjectiveType; slot below 32; returns objective word (virtual +0x40) masked with 1 << slot. Used by prerequisite type 94 with unit +0x35f8.
True for objective types 10; 13; 14; 18 and for 27/28 when the settler mission mode is 1 or 2.
Builds the class object stored at game +0x6d90 from the Class row: base constructor 1405e7330; subclass vtable chosen by the row mechanic word (1; 2; 4; 5; 6).
Base constructor of the class object (vtable 140b6e4a0); copies the innate ability spell ids of the Class row.

Class object virtual +0x60 (shared by all subclasses): first index of the eight Class.vitalEnumResource words equal to the vital id whose unit resource float (+0x21c + 4 * index) is positive; else 11. Default branch of Unit_GetCurrentVitalForPrerequisite.
Class table row by id; used by LocalPlayer_CreateClassMechanicObject.
Objective progress for Lua GetObjectiveCompleted: virtual +0x48 of the objective for checklist types (Quest_IsChecklistObjectiveType); +0x40 (raw word) otherwise; scaled for percentage objectives.
Percentage branch of Lua GetObjectiveCompleted for objectives with a count above 1 and without flag 0x400.
Objective count word; 100 for percentage-style objective types (2; 8; 15; 16; 46) without flag 0x200.
